preconditions.description: The number of water tanks n must be between 2 and 50.
The total increase in pipe width k must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= cij <= 10**6 for row in matrix for cij in row)
preconditions.description: Each pipe width cij must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(cij == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i == j)
preconditions.description: The diagonal elements of the matrix must be zero, indicating no self-loops.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum amount of water that can be transmitted from tank 1 to tank n.
